audit.why: Sustain tank who farms through poke with Infected Bonesaw (Q, 4s). Aatrox owns the early levels and loses the value war as Mundo stacks health.
Maximum Dosage (R) is a flat 120s heal-and-regen that scales off missing health, so resistances are the wrong answer — Grievous Wounds is. Existing level-6 and first-item text already say this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Goes Where He Pleases (P) resists the first immobilising effect, so your first Infernal Chains or Q3 knock-up is eaten by the cannister — the second one lands. Heart Zapper (W, 17/16.5/16/15.5/15) stores damage you deal and pays it back as healing.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Dr. Mundo. Infernal Chains (W) drags him back to the centre — but Goes Where He Pleases (P) eats your first immobilise, so spend one to break it, then land the real one. Heart Zapper (W, 17s at rank 1) stores your damage and pays it back as healing: buy Grievous Wounds before you commit.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Dr. Mundo. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive Maximum Dosage — never burn it for a single Q.
